subject: docs/deployment.md
source: docs/deployment.md states Alembic is the only schema source. A fresh Postgres runs alembic upgrade head. The existing Supabase database, created by initial_schema and enable_row_level_security with no alembic_version table, is aligned once with alembic stamp head after the schema matches c7a1b5e0d942. Later schema changes are new migrations applied with alembic upgrade head. RLS is already enabled on users, bank_connections, accounts, transactions, chat_cache, and chat_usage.
